properties.name: The held-out check did its job on the first try: 37 phrasings took the corpus from 42 misses to 5, and 19 of those passes fail a paraphrase written from a different angle — the sentences echoed the queries
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-11, minutes after the phrasings were first applied and BEFORE any were committed. The decision predicted this trap in its own text — "a sentence that merely copies the corpus query passes trivially and a differently-worded user still misses" — and named the held-out paraphrase corpus as the guard. The guard fired on the first pass.

    MAIN corpus (180)        pass 152   near 23   miss 5    (the 5 are over-budget tools, untouched so far)
    HELD-OUT paraphrases (42) pass 16   near 3    miss 23

**19 tools pass the main corpus and fail the held-out one.** `graph_report` passes "give me the overall health summary of the design" and misses "how healthy is the design right now". `get_node` passes "show me everything recorded about this one item" and misses "pull up the full record for that one requirement". `add_requirement` passes "write down something the system must do" and misses "the customer says it has to survive a 2g shock — capture that". The sentences were written hours after the queries by the same author and carried the same nouns. That is tuning, however unintended, and the number that says so is 19 of 42.

⚠️ NOT ALL 23 HELD-OUT MISSES ARE TUNING. Some paraphrases reach for domain words no lexical retrieval can carry — `budget_report` ← "are we over the mass allowance": the tool cannot know "mass" is a budget quantity in one project and "latency" in another. Those are the honest ceiling of word-matching, and the held-out corpus is what makes the ceiling visible rather than something to explain away. Judging which of the 23 is which is the next piece of work, per tool.

WHAT FOLLOWS: the 19 sentences are rewritten from the tool's PURPOSE to carry the job in more than one register — "the design's overall health — how it is doing, how healthy it is right now" — and both corpora re-scored. The held-out set stays OUT of CI so it cannot become the next thing tuned to; a third angle would be needed to check the rewrite the same way, and that is noted here rather than pretended.

BOUNDS: both corpora by one author on one day; held-out authored after the phrasings, so contaminated in the author's head if not on paper. n=42 for the held-out set.
